hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && s=$(find . -type f ! -name "*.md" ! -path "./.claude/*" ! -path "./.git/*" ! -path "./node_modules/*" ! -name ".*" ! -name "package*.json" -printf "%s\n" | awk "{t+=\$1} END {print t+0}"); if [ "$s" -gt 512000 ]; then printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"Site is %s KB, over the 500 KB limit\",\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Site files total %s bytes, over the 500 KB (512000 bytes) limit in CLAUDE.md. Reduce size before continuing.\"}}" $((s/1024)) "$s"; fi 2>/dev/null || true
